notes: Rear view shows '2 x Qwiic 4-pin' connectors. Upper connector labels printed as a stacked list GND, 3V3, (16)SDA, (15)SCL; lower as 'RX TX 5V GND' with 44 43 above RX TX. Numbers in parentheses/above are GPIO numbers, kept as functions. Encoder, touch, AMOLED and buzzer GPIO lists are internal assignments, not wiring points; skipped.
uncertain: Label-to-pin mapping for both Qwiic connectors is inferred: the labels are printed as lists beside the connectors with one leader line each, so which physical end is GND (upper) or RX (lower) is not explicit.
